subject: Fintrax compliance recap & evidence next steps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sahil Mehta <sahil.mehta@fintrax.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@fintrax.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fintrax compliance recap & evidence next steps

Hi Sahil / Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re all aligned on scope, pain, and next steps. I’ll keep this tight.

Key pain points you shared
- Auditability / proving end-to-end trace for model calls (audit log access + retention).
- Data residency and DPA terms (EU customers in scope for some product lines).
- Proof of SOC 2 controls and timing (you need artifacts for vendor risk review).
- Pen test window / scope for integration with your staging environment.

Primary goals you stated
1) Confirm Redwood can provide audit logs with a 90-day retention for production events (longer retention for archived exports).
2) Obtain SOC 2 Type II or roadmap + interim evidence aligned to your procurement timeline (targeting decision in Q4).
3) Define a minimal evidence intake set so your security team can run a quick initial risk assessment and unblock legal.

What we’ll do — proposed next steps
- I’ve attached a short SOC2-readiness-checklist that maps our common artifacts to DDQ items (attached).
- Please confirm the exact retention window you need (90 / 180 / other) and whether logs must be forwarded to your S3.
- If you can share preferred legal contact, we’ll prep a DPA draft and call out any SLAs.
- We propose a 2-week evidence sprint once you confirm scope; typical owners: Neha (evidence intake) + Karthik (pen-test coordination).

Proposed meeting: follow-up call on Aug 27 to review evidence mapping and timeline — does 10am PT work?

Attachments (stubs):
- SOC2-readiness-checklist.pdf (summary mapping + common artifacts)

Thanks — I’ll await the retention confirmation and legal contact.

Best,
Irene

From: Sahil Mehta <sahil.mehta@fintrax.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@fintrax.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fintrax compliance recap & evidence next steps

Irene — thanks for the summary, that captures the call well. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Retention: For production audit logs we need 180 days of readily queryable logs. We may request a 3rd-party export monthly to our S3 bucket for long-term archival; we can confirm the S3 details once legal signs off.
- SOC2: We’ll accept a current SOC 2 Type II report if available; if not, a SOC 2 roadmap + interim control evidence is okay but procurement will require at least 2 representative artifact types (e.g., access-control config export + logging policy).
- Pen test: Our security ops prefers vendors to support an external pen test window in staging; proposed window is Oct 4–8. We’ll need the pen-test scope and contact person to coordinate.

Next steps on our end: I’ll introduce our procurement lead (legal@fintrax.com) separately. For the follow-up call Aug 27, 10am PT works for Olivia and me.

On attachments/artifacts: can you share the intake template and an ETA for the two example artifacts you mentioned? Procurement likes to see a timeline in the evidence package.

Thanks,
Sahil
Sahil Mehta | Head of Product Security, Fintrax
sahil.mehta@fintrax.com | +1 (212) 555-0823
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sahil Mehta <sahil.mehta@fintrax.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@fintrax.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fintrax compliance recap & evidence next steps

Thanks Sahil — perfect, and good call on the 180-day retention. A few commitments from our side: 

- Evidence we can share this week: access-control config export (sanitized), logging policy excerpt, and our artifact mapping (these are included in the SOC2-readiness-checklist).
- I’ve attached an evidence-intake-template.csv to collect the items you need and owners; Neha will run the intake and map artifacts to DDQ items.
- Pen test: attaching a short pen-test-scope-proposal for your review (high level). Karthik will lead coordination with your ops and schedule the staging window if that date works.

Quick ask: can you confirm whether Fintrax requires vendor-signed DPA prior to evidence delivery? If so we’ll surface a DPA draft to legal once we have the procurement contact.

We’ll push the initial artifacts to the shared drive after this email and before the call on Aug 27. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-fintrax-evidence

On Aug 27 call we’ll: review the evidence package, confirm the 180-day retention mechanism (query vs forward), and set a pen-test SOW sign-off timeline.

Attachments (stubs):
- evidence-intake-template.csv
- pen-test-scope-proposal.pdf

Best,
Irene
